title: Sofiane & Rayan — Le book (BD cartoon)
style: Simple flat 2D cartoon illustration, bold clean black outlines, round expressive characters with big simple faces, solid flat colors, minimal background details, hand-drawn TikTok webcomic style, no text

characters.name: Sofiane
characters.description: Sofiane, a young cartoon man with short black curly hair, thick eyebrows, teal delivery jacket over a dark hoodie, tired expressive eyes

characters.name: Rayan
characters.description: Rayan, a cartoon man with a neat short beard, camel-colored overcoat, confident smile, expressive hands

characters.name: Nadia
characters.description: Nadia, an elegant cartoon businesswoman, dark hair with a silver streak in a low bun, burgundy blazer, sharp kind eyes

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: Sofiane ?! Depuis quand tu livres des sushis, toi ?

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Rayan frozen mid-step on a night street, eyes huge with shock, mouth wide open speaking, pointing forward, warm restaurant glow behind him

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Depuis que mon bac plus cinq intéresse personne.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Sofiane holding a big thermal delivery bag, bitter half-smile, mouth open speaking, one eyebrow raised, night street

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: Attends… t'as un master en marketing !

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Rayan frowning in disbelief, hands spread wide, mouth open speaking, big question marks doodled around his head

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Deux cents candidatures, Rayan. Deux cents.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Sofiane holding up two fingers, dead serious face, mouth open speaking, a rain of tiny doodled rejection envelopes falling around him

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Ceux qui décrochent les postes, ils ont un oncle, un contact. Moi j'ai personne.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Sofiane sitting slumped on his delivery scooter, talking with a resigned shrug, empty dark street, one small streetlamp

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: C'est pas ce que tu sais. C'est qui tu connais.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Rayan pointing at the viewer with a knowing look, mouth open speaking, a doodled web of little connected faces floating behind him
Cartoon Sofiane with a deadpan flat stare, arms crossed, mouth barely open in a sarcastic mutter, tiny storm cloud doodled above his head

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: Jeudi soir. Un dîner. Huit personnes qui bossent, qui montent des boîtes. Tu viens.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Rayan holding up his phone showing a warm little dinner-table app card with eight chairs, determined grin, mouth open speaking

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Je vais dire quoi, moi ? Que je livre des makis ?

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Sofiane gesturing at his own delivery jacket with self-mocking irony, mouth open speaking, sweat drop doodled on his temple

dialogue.speaker: rayan
dialogue.text: Que t'as un master et faim de bosser. Le reste, ça se voit tout seul.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Rayan gripping Sofiane's shoulder firmly, speaking with warm confident eyes, Sofiane listening surprised, streetlamp halo

dialogue.speaker: nadia
dialogue.text: Deux cents candidatures et personne ne vous a rappelé ? Leur erreur.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Nadia at a candlelit dinner table, chin on her hand, calm authority, mouth open speaking, slight smile

dialogue.speaker: nadia
dialogue.text: Je monte une marque. Envoyez-moi votre book lundi.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Nadia extending a business card across the dinner table, direct warm gaze, mouth open speaking, candle flame between
Cartoon Sofiane in a clean white shirt receiving the card with both hands like a treasure, eyes shining, big smile breaking through as he speaks

dialogue.speaker: sofiane
dialogue.text: Je crois que je viens de rencontrer ma future boss.

scenes.image_prompt: Cartoon Rayan grinning with arms open outside the restaurant at night, Sofiane laughing holding up the business card, little doodled stars of joy around them

scenes.vo: Ton réseau commence autour d'une vraie table. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
